method: Curated global pressure cases. Quantities use the boundary stated in each record and must not be summed across incompatible units or area definitions.

commodities.pressure_pt: Salmouras podem alterar balanços hídricos de salares; rocha dura implica cavas, britagem, rejeitados e energia.
commodities.pressure_en: Brines can alter salt-flat water balances; hard rock entails pits, crushing, tailings and energy.

commodities.pressure_pt: Grandes volumes de rocha para pequenas quantidades de metal, cianeto, mercúrio artesanal e drenagem ácida.
commodities.pressure_en: Large rock volumes for small metal yields, cyanide, artisanal mercury and acid drainage.

commodities.pressure_pt: Cavas extensas, teor decrescente, consumo de água e energia e enormes volumes de rejeitados.
commodities.pressure_en: Large pits, declining ore grade, water and energy demand and huge tailings volumes.

commodities.pressure_pt: Laterites tropicais podem exigir remoção florestal; sulfuretos podem gerar drenagem ácida.
commodities.pressure_en: Tropical laterites can require forest clearance; sulphides can generate acid drainage.

commodities.pressure_pt: Extração a céu aberto, ferrovia, portos, poeiras, rejeitados e transformação de paisagens florestais.
commodities.pressure_en: Open-pit extraction, railways, ports, dust, tailings and transformation of forest landscapes.

commodities.pressure_pt: Separação química intensa e resíduos que podem conter metais pesados e radionuclídeos.
commodities.pressure_en: Chemical-intensive separation and waste that may contain heavy metals and radionuclides.

commodities.pressure_pt: Remoção de solo e habitat, subsidência, drenagem ácida, metano e combustão incompatível com metas climáticas.
commodities.pressure_en: Soil and habitat removal, subsidence, acid drainage, methane and combustion incompatible with climate goals.
